connect.docs: What is sent, when, and how to verify it

connection.title: Connect this installation to Ever Platform
connection.description: Connect with a code from app.ever.co: workspaces can then be linked to an Ever organization (ever.co/<handle>), and the organization can enable integrations after a recorded consent. Nothing is sent until you connect, and Ever Rec keeps working the same whatever happens to the connection.
connection.workspace: First workspace to link (one you administer)
connection.sentProduct: the product (Ever Rec) and its version ({{version}})
connection.sentWorkspace: the id and name of the workspace you pick
connection.sentKey: the public key of this installation's connection key
connection.notSent: No address of this installation, no user, no e-mail and no file is sent.
connection.publicUrlHint: Sent only after the organization enabled "Installation address" in app.ever.co.
connection.publicUrlSaved: The address was saved and sent.
connection.rotateConfirm: A new connection key is created and used once Ever Platform accepted it. The anonymous usage statistics are not affected.
connection.disconnectConfirm: Ever Platform is told, then every integration is switched off, every workspace link is ended and the entitlements are deleted here. Ever Rec itself and the anonymous usage statistics are not affected. You can connect again with a new code.

link.description: Link this workspace to its Ever organization with a link code from app.ever.co.
link.notConnected: This installation is not connected to Ever Platform: its operator connects it first.
link.sameOrg: The workspace is linked. Another workspace of this installation is linked to the same organization.
link.unlinkConfirm: Ever Platform is told, and the integrations of this link stop. The workspace and its content stay as they are.
